name: Clash Remotion execution plugin
purpose: Owns the render-timeline Action and its immutable browser bundle resource.
invariants: Timeline media enters as frozen clash-asset handles and is resolved only through ExecutorContext.reference.
Only executor-url delivery is accepted; Host paths and Asset bytes never enter the Timeline invocation.
Rendered MP4 output is returned through the Action SDK media upload path at the Generator's declared render:output slot; it is not an extra invocation parameter.
The executor imports the pure shared-types/timeline-envelope contract, never the shared-types root or collaboration/YAML runtime. Its built ESM payload must load in plain Node without require shims.
